name: wheel-of-the-twelve
about: Our own painting: the old star atlas's zodiac wheel of Eorzea turning round the night sky, the Twelve's twelve signs set in its gilt band in the calendar's order, each four stars over the atlas's faint engraving of its emblem, the pole star at the hub, a rose nebula in the wheel's heart and the Milky Way behind (painters/twelve.py; shipped as a JPEG). The first jewel is the night's blue (the painting's sky is painted blue and the jewel keeps 0.2 of its colour, so it measures about 261 rather than the violet 285 a violet sky gave); the second is the nebula's rose, a broad disc over the wheel's heart (r 195), whose feather is kept to 55 so its edge does not mix down into the 300-330 hues (at 90 the pair was 46 degrees apart; F7 needs 60). The wheel's own ellipse as the region's shape failed the print check, since its edge runs through the signs.

palette.name: Indigo night and the nebula's rose (the Twelve's wheel)
